subject: Re: CAIQ control mapping, sampling timeline, and evidence escalation
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@shieldbank.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: security@shieldbank.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ submission: request for control mappings + sample evidence

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the demo last week — ShieldBank is moving quickly on our evaluation. We need a CAIQ control crosswalk and representative evidence for a subset of controls in our initial audit window. Primary asks:
- A completed CAIQ JSON/CSV crosswalk mapping Redwood’s assertions to CSA control IDs (we’ll be reviewing 10 controls as a pilot: IaaS segmentation, key management, tenant isolation, logging/traceability, crypto in transit, privileged access, change management, backup/recovery, monitoring, and SLA/incident response).
- Representative artifacts for each control (logs, runbooks, attestation text, exportable telemetry snippets). We do not need full exports for all controls — samples that demonstrate collection + retention for prod are fine.
- A short sampling timeline: when and how you’ll deliver the artifacts, and who at Redwood will be the control owner contact.

ShieldBank is working on a tight window — we need the crosswalk by EOD 2027-04-05 and sample artifacts staged by 2027-04-09. Are these timelines feasible? Also include any known exclusions (e.g., third-party infra managed by cloud provider).

Appreciate a clear owner and a single archive link for the handoff (we prefer Drive links or DocuSign packages for gated artifacts).

Best,
Emily Chen
Senior InfoSec Manager
ShieldBank

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@shieldbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: CAIQ submission: request for control mappings + sample evidence

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Short answer: yes, we can meet the pilot window with a targeted sampling plan. Summary plan below.

Plan (high level):
- Deliverable 1 (by 2027-04-05 EOD): CAIQ crosswalk CSV + narrative column with per-assertion notes.
- Deliverable 2 (by 2027-04-09 EOD): Evidence bundle (zipped) with 2–3 representative artifacts per prioritized control and a README that explains where each artifact was captured and how to interpret it.
- Owners:
  - Crosswalk and assertions: Priya Natarajan (Controls lead)
  - Runtime logs & telemetry samples: David Kim (Infra/Telemetry)
  - Artifact curation and packaging: Marissa Cole (Assurance Program)
  - Control acceptance clarifications: Kimberly Park (Control owner liaison)

Known notes/exclusions: logs from the underlying cloud hypervisor are third-party (we will provide the telemetry that Redwood collects only). Where KMS is backed by customer-provided CMEK, we’ll document the flow and provide key rotation attestations.

Attachments I’ll stage: redwood_ca-toolkit.zip (crosswalk template + example annotations), control_crosswalk_v1.xlsx (working draft). I’ll share a Drive link in the next email once artifacts are zipped.

Does that work for ShieldBank? If you want a brief sync tomorrow (15–20 min) to align expectations we can schedule.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Manager, Controls & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@shieldbank.com>, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: david_kim@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 14:35:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: CAIQ submission: request for control mappings + sample evidence

Emily — attaching the working bundle we’ll hand off on Monday. See the quick contents list below and the escalation note at the end.

Attachments (stubs):
- redwood_ca-toolkit.zip (contains: crosswalk-template.csv, narrative-guidance.md, artifact-labeling-schema.txt)
- control_crosswalk_v1.xlsx (mapping for pilot 10 controls, columned by CSA ID and Redwood assertion)
- playbook-evidence-checklist.pdf (how to validate artifacts + sampling rationale)

Pickup notes:
- Sampling rationale: for telemetry controls we provide a 24-hour contiguous capture from prod during normal traffic and one post-deploy snapshot to show change-management linkage. For privileged access and key rotation we provide recent audit logs and rotation records (redacted for PII).
- Evidence formats: logs (csv/plaintext snippets), runbook (PDF), signed attestation (PDF), telemetry export (ndjson subset).

Escalation/edge case: Kimberly and David flagged that control CCM-1.4 (tenant boundary enforcement) has a dependent audit from our provider for the hypervisor layer. We will provide Redwood-side mitigations and the provider attestation reference, but ShieldBank may want to accept a compensating-control note vs full provider logs. If ShieldBank insists on provider-level artifacts, that will require an extended window to coordinate with the provider and add ~2 weeks.

Proposed next step: we’ll upload the staged zip to the shared Drive on Monday morning (2027-04-05) and send download + index link. If you want an in-person/Zoom walk-through of the artifacts once uploaded, we can do that Tuesday.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Program Manager, Assurance
Redwood Inference

From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@shieldbank.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: security@shieldbank.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: CAIQ submission: request for control mappings + sample evidence

Thanks — this looks good and aligns with ShieldBank’s needs. A couple of quick clarifications before you package:
1) For the telemetry output, can you include timestamps in UTC and a short README showing the query or API call used to extract the 24-hour sample?
2) For the key rotation evidence, a redacted rotation table is fine, but we need the KMS key IDs and rotation cadence documented in the narrative column.
3) Regarding CCM-1.4: we accept a compensating-control note for now but would prefer the provider attestation link; please mark this as "Provider-Dependency" in the crosswalk so our auditors can see the trace.

We’ll plan a 30-minute walkthrough on Tue 2027-04-06 10:00am PT to review artifacts and escalate any follow-ups. Can Priya / Marissa / David / Kimberly attend?

Best,
Emily Chen
Senior InfoSec Manager
ShieldBank
